# Creative QA findings

Every finding has a stable code, a category (it feeds that category's score) and a severity. Errors fail the critique;
warnings and infos lower the score. Messages name the shot or metric behind them.

| Category | Code | Severity | Example message |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| rhythm | CUTS_OFF_BEAT | error | only …% of the cuts land on the beat grid (beat sync dial …) |
| rhythm | CUTS_LOOSE | warning | …% of the cuts land on the beat grid; a beat-synced edit should be above 80% |
| rhythm | NO_REAL_BEATS | warning | the cuts follow a virtual grid, not the music: supply a music track so the edit can really sync to it |
| rhythm | DROP_NOT_CUT | warning | the drop at …s has no cut on it |
| sound | DROP_NO_SFX | warning | no impact sound on the drop at …s |

| pacing | METRONOME | warning | every shot is almost the same length: the cut has no rhythm of its own |
| pacing | FLASH_SHOT | warning | … lasts …s: too short to read |
